item.title: Curio Dealer
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: AXL
  • 発売日: 2018-06-29
  • スコア: 7.06/10 (42 人評価)
  • 日本語名: キュリオディーラー
  • 英語名: Curio Dealer

あらすじ

Rajasthan is a town that sits at the foot of a huge tower that is said to have been built by an ancient civilization and is so tall that it appears it can reach the heavens. There are many unknown machines and objects found in the tower which can be sold for large sums of money, but it is guarded by robots which seek to exterminate all intruders. It is up to adventurers to complete this dangerous job of obtaining these treasures.

item.title: Ai Yori Aoi Umi no Hate
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: AXL
  • 発売日: 2017-06-30
  • スコア: 6.9799999999999995/10 (19 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アイよりアオい海の果て
  • 英語名: Ai Yori Aoi Umi no Hate

あらすじ

In the future, nations and civilizations have disappeared due to rising sea levels caused by tectonic movements and global warming. The survivors lacked technique and talent, but they were able to restore an ancient battleship and attach a spare hydrogen engine to it. Then, a long long time passed, and all land was inundated by the sea, and humans barely survived aboard the self-navigating self-repairing ship.

item.title: Ou no Mimi ni wa Todokanai!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: AXL
  • 発売日: 2016-12-22
  • スコア: 7.2/10 (42 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 王の耳には届かない！
  • 英語名: Ou no Mimi ni wa Todokanai!

别名

  • It does not reach the ears of the king!

あらすじ

The village of Baarle is situated in a corner of the Reste Kingdom, near the border. The protagonist Cactus used to be part of the ‘Izayoi Knights’, also known as the ‘Ears of the King’, but he left after a certain incident. He quickly turned into a useless person and roamed across the country until he arrived at Baarle. Now he serves as the self-proclaimed bodyguard for the town while avoiding his actual job of tending the fields. He keeps getting reprimanded by the village elder Nastur, but he has found himself a home thanks to the goodwill of the villagers.

item.title: Koi Suru Otome to Shugo no Tate ~Bara no Seibo~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: AXL
  • 発売日: 2016-02-26
  • スコア: 7.5/10 (74 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 恋する乙女と守護の楯 ～薔薇の聖母～
  • 英語名: Koi Suru Otome to Shugo no Tate Bara no Seibo

あらすじ

Because of his success in the events at St. Theresia Academy, Kisaragi Shuuji (Shield 9) has obtained a firm position within Aegis. That is, as the one in charge of “Crossdress infiltration”. Since the previous events he has successfully completed several more assignments, and currently considers stepping down from the position. Unfortunately for him however, he has been tasked with just 1 more assignment. This time, his task involves another all-girls school similar to St. Theresia Academy. He has to run in the elections for student council president and success in obtaining the position.

item.title: Ayakashi Contract
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: AXL
  • 発売日: 2015-05-29
  • スコア: 7.1/10 (41 人評価)
  • 日本語名: あやかしコントラクト
  • 英語名: Ayakashi Contract

别名

  • Ayacon

あらすじ

Due to his parents’ constant work transfers, Yukiya hasn’t been able to make any close friends. This time, he opposed following his parents overseas and decided to live with his uncle’s family in the rural Housenshu-chou and transfer into the school there. After a long train ride, he lost his way in the forest and was helped by a great spirit called the Guardian of the Forest. The next morning, he found the tanuki youkai Shouji by his side, pressing him to fulfill his promised contract of helping solve the spirits’ worries.

item.title: Racial Merge
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: AXL
  • 発売日: 2014-04-25
  • スコア: 7.359999999999999/10 (71 人評価)
  • 日本語名: レーシャル・マージ
  • 英語名: Racial Merge

あらすじ

Will was the first youth from his remote village in 50 years to be selected for the elite school in the capital. Lovingly raised by the town’s elderly folks, he was a kind fellow who possessed great knowledge and technique. However, there were no young women in the area. They gave him a warm send-off and told him not to come back until he found a bride. Along the way to the capital, he came upon a lot of young women and also many people in trouble. His kindness led him to coming to aid of a blind girl Meryl, but she didn’t thank him in return. Later, he met her at the school, where she worked as a maid.

item.title: Hyakka Ryouran Elixir
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: AXL
  • 発売日: 2013-04-26
  • スコア: 7.15/10 (48 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 百花繚乱エリクシル
  • 英語名: Hyakka Ryouran Elixir

别名

  • Record of Myrtus Revival

あらすじ

The ‘patrolling messengers’ monitored the feudal lords in the kingdom for the emperor. They were orphans who were raised personally by the emperor himself, and only the best of the best were able to be named as one. However, the feudal lords knew that so long as they did not commit any grave crimes, the messengers would not take any action. Moreover, since they were not related to the royal family, they were easily coerced by others’ political strengths.

item.title: Itoshii Kanojo no Mamorikata
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: AXL
  • 発売日: 2011-05-27
  • スコア: 7.2/10 (74 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 愛しい対象の護り方
  • 英語名: Itoshii Kanojo no Mamorikata

别名

  • 愛しい対象（カノジョ）の護り方

あらすじ

Yuuto enrolled in a military school in order to fulfill a childhood promise with Yui. But when he met her again, she demanded to know why he came there. He realized that her smile had disappeared. This is because their class is ridiculed for being weaker than other classes. Their classroom is not well furnished and his bed is more like a table. Their teacher announces that there will be a battle in which the rewards will be a proper desk and chairs… and an air conditioner as well! Yuuto decides to help their class win this battle and bring a smile back to Yui’s face.

item.title: Kashimashi Communication
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: AXL
  • 発売日: 2010-02-26
  • スコア: 7.06/10 (37 人評価)
  • 日本語名: かしましコミュニケーション
  • 英語名: Kashimashi Communication

あらすじ

Joutarou has average grades and isn’t bad at nor excels at athletics: basically an ordinary student. But, he’s famous in the school since he works for the ‘cross-cultural committee’. This isn’t your normal club; the members are interested in UFO and aliens, ghosts and spirits. He wishes for someone normal and one day he gets his wish in the form of a lost girl from another country. What he doesn’t know is that she’s actually a princess.

item.title: Kimi no Koe ga Kikoeru

  • 日本語名: キミの声がきこえる
  • 英語名: Kimi no Koe ga Kikoeru

别名

  • キミ声

あらすじ

Naoya fails the university entrance examination, and starts to study at a preparatory school. He meets Sakura, Miyuki and Ouka there and enjoys his life. On the other hand, his father tells him to go and help the hotel, owned by his father. He also meets beautiful girls including Izumi, his childhood friend, there and enjoys his peaceful life. Naoya is busy with studying, loving and working! Sakura, Izumi and Miyuki… Love with girls, friendship with friends, long distance love and triple cohabitation…? What will happen to Naoya in the end?

item.title: Hidamari
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: AXL
  • 発売日: 2006-05-26
  • スコア: 6.76/10 (25 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ひだまり
  • 英語名: Hidamari

あらすじ

There is an old apartment, where nobody lives because there is a rumor that people who live there will be dogged by misfortune. The apartment is owned by Kouhei, a uni student whose parents passed away when he was a child. Kouhei has a special ability that he can talk to ghosts. By using this ability, he sometimes talks to his deceased parents so that he never feels lonely. One day, two students transfer to his class, Yuki and Akari. They are so pretty that every male student gets excited. However, Kouhei can see two ghosts behind them…
